summary: Frontend-only testing of new Weekly Digest admin panel (/admin/weekly-digest). Verified sidebar link, page load with data-testid, toggle switch ON/OFF flow (ended OFF as requested), stats (audiencia=2890, retiros=10, destacadas=1), preview modal + iframe content (contains '↳ Respuesta', '★ Pregunta destacada', no 'Administrador'/'Moderador', shows amounts), refresh button, empty runs state, Send-now confirm dialog cancelled (NOT accepted), regression on /admin/questions. All flows PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: Preview modal (Dialog) may leave iframe intercepting pointer events briefly after closing via Escape; consider adding onOpenChange cleanup or focusing outside iframe to avoid rare click intercept issues. Not blocking.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Weekly Digest panel verified end-to-end via Playwright. Toggle left in DESACTIVADO. Confirm dialog for 'Enviar ahora' shows message '¿Enviar el Resumen Semanal ahora a 2890 usuarios activos?' and was correctly dismissed (no real emails sent). Iframe preview contains withdrawals list with USD amounts, dates, country flags, plus featured question with '↳ Respuesta' and no admin/mod role leakage.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no issues found. Minor note: when clicking 'digest-send-now-btn' immediately after closing preview via Escape, the portal-root iframe can intercept clicks in Playwright; workaround: click send-now before opening preview, or fully close dialog by clicking outside/close-button.
